text:
maria: pinging vendor + infra team — we have a weekend load test scheduled Sun 03:00 PDT. Can someone confirm capacity and a temporary quota bump for 5 x A100s in us-west2 for ~2h? I opened TF PR #7892 for the ephemeral pool, please review when you can.

sam: talked to vendor earlier, they said they need a heads-up by Friday AM. I'll request a provisional hold and ask for priority.

lee: oncall — FYI we can fall back to spot but expect latency variance. What's the acceptable SLA for the test?

jo: skimmed the PR, infra side looks good. left one comment on the autoscaler policy (min/max). @sam — can you confirm billing/PO for the weekend burst?

vendor-supply-bot: Vendor inventory check: provisional allocation available in us-west2 for 5 x A100 for 48h starting 2026-04-03 02:00 UTC. Confirm within 12h to hold.

sam: ok provisional from vendor — need PO signoff. @finance who can approve a weekend one-off? @maria have you estimated cost?

maria: estimate ~ $1.8k for the 2h window including premium. We can route from demo/credits if finance can't do a PO fast.

jo: we should add a fallback route to the H100 pool in case of preemption. I can add the routing rule to the PR once PO confirmed.

lee: ops note — set eviction buffer to 3m and enable fast-restart. Adding runbook snippet below:

```
# quick runbook snippet
kubectl scale deploy inference-ephemeral --replicas=0 && sleep 15 && kubectl scale deploy inference-ephemeral --replicas=5
# watch pods: kubectl get pods -l app=inference -w
```

maria: :thumbsup: I'll confirm by EOD. If finance denies, plan is: spot fallback + reduce concurrent workers to 2.

sam: filing PO request now. attaching vendor quote: http://vendor.example/quote/1234

jo: :eyes: I pushed an autoscaler tweak to PR — changed `max_replicas = 6` -> `8` to allow burst headroom.

lee: noted. I'll watch metrics during the run. Good to go once PO + vendor CONFIRM.

vendor-supply-bot: Allocation held until 2026-04-02T20:00Z pending PO. Reply with 'CONFIRM' to finalize.
